scenes.big: Missed appointments cost clinics real money
scenes.say: Missed appointments are lost income for a clinic. Reminders are the simplest fix.

scenes.title: Reminder workflow
steps: Reply C to cancel: slot freed
scenes.say: Every hour, the workflow reads upcoming bookings. It sends a friendly reminder a day before, a short nudge two hours before, and if the patient replies to cancel, the slot is freed.
scenes.caption: 24h reminder, 2h nudge, easy cancel

cards.title: Build tip
lines: Store 'reminder sent' in the booking row so a patient never gets the same message twice.

scenes.say: Tip: mark each reminder as sent in the booking row, so nobody gets the same message twice.
scenes.caption: Mark reminders as sent to avoid duplicates
